tc: TC is a crystalline metallic element not found in nature.
TC can also mean a permanent council of the United Nations that commissions a country to undertake the administration of a territory.
TC means the same as technetium or atomic number 43 or Trusteeship Council.
tce: TCE is a heavy colorless highly toxic liquid used as a solvent to clean electronic components and for dry cleaning and as a fumigant.
TCE means the same as trichloroethylene or trichloroethane.
tchad: Tchad is a landlocked desert republic in north-central Africa.
Tchad means the same as Chad or Republic of Chad.
tchaikovsky: Tchaikovsky is important Russian composer whose works are noted for their expressive melodies.
Tchaikovsky means the same as Peter Tchaikovsky or Peter Ilich Tchaikovsky or Pyotr Tchaikovsky.
tchotchke: Tchotchke is an attractive, unconventional woman.
Tchotchke can also mean an inexpensive showy trinket.
Tchotchke means the same as chachka or tsatske or tshatshke.
tchotchkeleh: Tchotchkeleh is an attractive, unconventional woman.
Tchotchkeleh means the same as chachka or tsatske or tshatshke.
tcp: TCP is a protocol developed for the internet to get data from one network device to another.
For example: "TCP uses a retransmission strategy to insure that data will not be lost in transmission."
TCP means the same as transmission control protocol.
tcp/ip: TCP/IP is a set of protocols developed for the internet in the 1970s to get data from one network device to another.
TCP/IP means the same as transmission control protocol/internet protocol.
